correctness.rationale: The Chari--Joswig rooted forest model is equivariantly reversed to the incoming-degree orientation. Geometric fixed barycentric coordinates give an exact orbit-barycenter complex. All involution arrow orbits and quotient-cycle lifts are classified. Kozlov--Jojić complete-source shellability and Moradi--Khosh-Ahang expansion shellability prove a pure wedge-of-top-spheres homotopy type for all nonempty parameters. Chebotarev--Shamis directed matrix--forest theorem plus the written Laplacian spectrum derives the exact sphere multiplicity and f=1 contractibility. The standalone checker independently verifies original-arrow faces, mod-two ranks and Euler counts for ten pairs and the empty exception; no finite extrapolation is used.

broader_coverage.reasoning: The independent block product is strictly stronger than the single simultaneous transposition, and disallows paired-to-paired arrow orbits that exist here. In particular f=0,t>=2 gives empty product fixed locus but a nonempty sphere wedge for the diagonal involution. The equivariant character theorem covers the Euler number, not geometric fixed homotopy; the latter is not a logical corollary of an alternating trace without separate concentration/shellability arguments.

originality.rationale: Direct full-text comparison with the equivariant graph-Morse matrix--forest record finds coverage of the alternating trace/Euler number, which is credited, but not the actual geometric fixed-space homotopy or its shellability. The own closest independent block-action fixed-space claim is not covering: joint diagonal pair swaps permit pair-to-pair arrow orbits absent under independent swaps. The four named implication checks and six primary/source inspections show no identified equivalent or stronger classification, while acknowledging residual unindexed-literature risk.
residual_risks: A previously unindexed theorem could already classify these individual diagonal involution fixed spaces.
General equivariant shellability literature might contain a broader criterion that subsumes the geometric identification, despite no such implication appearing in inspected sources.

value.rationale: The theorem provides an exact integral homotopy classification over every nontrivial involution cycle type, with sharp empty/contractible/sphere-wedge boundaries. It isolates the effect of simultaneous versus independent pair swaps and identifies nonempty fixed topology with zero fixed underlying graph vertices. It goes well beyond routine Euler counts and has a natural topological symmetry invariant and complete parametric answer.
